dialogue: USER
Hi! I'd like to book an appointment for counseling.
ASSISTANT
I'd love to help you set up a consultation! What is your name, and what day and time tends to work best for you?
USER
My name is Jessica Taylor and I'm hoping to do Wednesday, October 14 at 4pm.
ASSISTANT
Got it, I've noted Wednesday, October 14, 2026 (4pm) as your preference, Jessica Taylor. What's the best email or phone number for our team to confirm that with you?
USER
My email is jessica.taylor@example.com, phone is 555-234-5678.
ASSISTANT
Got it, I've noted Wednesday, October 14, 2026 (4pm) as your preference for Jessica Taylor. Our team will review counselor availability and follow up with you shortly to confirm.
USER
Hello! Who are the therapists on your team and what are their specialties?
ASSISTANT

I'd love to help connect you with the right counselor on our team. To suggest the best match, could you share a little about what you're hoping to work through (such as anxiety, couples counseling, or life transitions)?

Or if you prefer, we can schedule an initial consultation, answer questions about our services, or check our current office hours.

Please note: Final therapist assignment is always made by our practice's clinical team based on clinical fit and therapist availability. This suggestion is a starting point for our team to review with you.
USER
My husband and I are having a lot of communication issues and constant arguments. Who would be the best fit for couples therapy?
ASSISTANT

Based on what you've shared, I'd suggest Marcus Reyes, LMFT.

Marcus specializes in couples counseling and communication patterns using Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT).

Our clinical team will confirm therapist fit and availability when scheduling.

Please note: Final therapist assignment is always made by our practice's clinical team based on clinical fit and therapist availability. This suggestion is a starting point for our team to review with you.
USER
Does Dr. Elena Marsh also do individual therapy or just couples?
ASSISTANT

Dr. Elena Marsh, PsyD — Licensed Clinical Psychologist **Specialties:** Anxiety disorders, depression, trauma (EMDR-trained), life transitions

Let me know if you'd like more details on this!
USER
Hi, I've been feeling stressed at work lately.
ASSISTANT

About MindBridge Wellness — Who We Serve - Adults navigating anxiety, depression, stress, or life transitions

Let me know if you'd like more details on this!
USER
I'd rather not share my name or email address right now, I prefer to keep this private.
ASSISTANT
No problem at all, we can keep chatting here without your contact info! What questions can I answer for you?
USER
Can you just tell me if sessions are offered online or in-person?
ASSISTANT

We offer both in-person sessions at our office and secure video telehealth across the state.

Which format works best for you?
USER
Hi there, I'm just looking around and exploring options, not sure what I need.
ASSISTANT

No worries at all! I'm happy to help you figure that out. Would you like to:
  • Schedule an initial consultation with one of our counselors
  • Ask something specific (like insurance, fees, or therapy approaches)
  • Check our office hours and services
Which of those sounds most helpful to explore right now?
USER
What are your office hours and what insurance plans do you accept?
ASSISTANT

We're open Monday through Saturday, with evening appointments available on select weekdays.

Our intake team will confirm exact times when setting up your session.
USER
Thank you, that's helpful information for now.
ASSISTANT
You're very welcome! Feel free to reach out anytime whenever you're ready or have more questions. We're always here to help.
USER
I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately. My chest gets tight and I feel dizzy at work, and I can't sleep at night. What is wrong with me?
ASSISTANT

I can't provide a diagnosis or medical assessment, as only a licensed clinician can do that. Our therapists at MindBridge Wellness would be glad to talk through what you're feeling in an initial session.
USER
Can you diagnose what I have? Do you think I need Xanax or some kind of medication?
ASSISTANT

I cannot provide a diagnosis or medical assessment, as only a licensed physician or psychiatrist can do that. Our therapists at MindBridge Wellness provide evidence-based counseling and would be glad to talk through what you're experiencing in an initial session.
USER
Okay, I understand. I'm Michael, my email is michael.ross@example.com. How do I get started?
ASSISTANT
Thanks so much for sharing that! Our intake coordinator will reach out shortly to help you get scheduled. In the meantime, is there anything else I can help with?
